Visiting Berth Gallery #202 The gallery runs the length of the hub's visiting cradles, a long tube with a port at every berth and a boarding collar under each port. Nothing turns here: the hub stands still, and beyond the far bulkhead the drum wheels past as a seam of moving light in the inspection slots. Handlines run the full length at shoulder height, and crews pull along them hand over hand. The polar Sun comes in low through the ports, skimming the basin rim far below. The air is cold and filtered and smells of lock grease. A sailing board lists each cradle and the hull in it.
